survey.what_is_it: library/engine — Echo, horde's standard delay: a C++ stereo delay engine library that horde hosts as one module in its FX rack, plus a browser lab twin for listening. NOT a standalone plugin for now (Q1; a plugin is a later, logged decision). Boundary ruled by horde: diffusion makes it Scape, discrete repeats make it Echo, morphing the graph makes it Sluice.

architecture_rung.earned_by: Impulse-response invariants (time accuracy in samples, generation ratio = feedback, the ceiling, exact-zero tails) give a fresh-context verifier mechanical ground truth from the first C++ build. Rung 1 rejected: no independent eye over a core that agrees with its author. Rung 3 rejected: one shared core, no independent verifiable seams, no demonstrated bottleneck.

survey.domain_core_llm_must_not_own: Stereo delay lines with fractional reads; free (ms) or tempo-synced time by horde's division names, with L/R offsets; standard (dual mono / stereo), ping-pong and mid/side routing; feedback with a ceiling on the returning term only (ADR-142's fix — never divide loop gain by tap count, never limit the dry path); input, loop (delay-line) and output filters, truly bypassed when off; modulation modes, repitch among them; every test signal and detector. Deterministic code only: seeded mulberry32 streams, no wall-clock reads, tempo arrives as data, no model in the path. AI proposes and judges at design time only.

max_delay.rationale: Covers 2/1 at 40 bpm (12 s). Chosen by poll at survey (Q3b). Time + L/R offset clamp to the line length; the exact clamp behaviour is a Phase A spec item.
max_delay.memory: Delay lines alone, stereo float32: 12 s × SR × 2 ch × 4 B = 4.39 MiB at 48 kHz, 8.79 MiB at 96 kHz, 17.58 MiB at 192 kHz (the rack runs at the host rate, ADR-237). All of it allocated at prepare. The full per-instance worst-case figure (filter, modulation and visualizer state included) is stated at M1 — the 1.0 bar's MUST row.

oracle_shape.goldens: INVARIANTS FIRST, then pinned goldens. Spec and impulse-response invariants, every detector with a must-fail (planted) control: time accuracy in samples; generation ratio equals the feedback exactly with filters bypassed; the ceiling holds past unity; sample-rate and block-size independence; silence in → exact zero out, and exact zero when the declared tail ends; modulation depth and repitch accuracy in cents; mono-fold metrics for ping-pong and mid/side; the click metric under moving time. Per-preset goldens pinned once the C++ exists, never before (ADR-142's lesson: parity must not enshrine a defect).
oracle_shape.layer_0: ./verify fast — kit gates (integrity, leak) + private-name alias gate + structure/manifest sanity from day zero; grows the C++ invariant tests and the lab determinism scan as they land.
oracle_shape.layer_e: ./verify full — fast + goldens + sweeps; CPU in Release as a ratio to a calibration loop, reported, NEVER a gate.
oracle_shape.ci: fast only (Linux runner; public repo, so no minutes budget); full is local.

second_implementation.note: The lab is a listening twin, never a parity target. The C++ core is the reference from day one, judged by its invariants. The legacy delay (intake/legacy/) is a reference only, never a parity target.
